properties.name: log-viewer.enabled
properties.description: Master switch for the in-browser log viewer (LogViewerController and its /admin/logs/** endpoints). When false the controller is not registered — no viewer/data/inflight/trace/page endpoints — while request-id, exclusions, compression, and the slow-request watchdog keep working. Set false where /admin/logs/** cannot be authenticated: with no Spring Security on the classpath the viewer is otherwise unprotected.

properties.name: log-viewer.required-authority
properties.description: Authority required to access /admin/logs/** via the fallback security chain (WebLogSecurityAutoConfiguration). Blank means any authenticated principal; set e.g. ROLE_ADMIN to restrict further. Only consulted when the fallback chain is active (Spring Security present, no overriding chain).

properties.name: log-viewer.access-log-directory
properties.description: Directory where Tomcat access log files are written. Relative paths are resolved against catalina.base (set via server.tomcat.basedir). Must be consistent with server.tomcat.basedir in the consumer app.

properties.name: log-viewer.excluded-prefixes
properties.description: URI path prefixes (after context-path is stripped) that are excluded from the Tomcat access log and written to exclusions.log instead. Default: /admin/logs, /swagger-ui, /v3/api-docs, /actuator.

properties.name: log-viewer.silent-prefixes
properties.description: URI path prefixes (after context-path is stripped) suppressed from BOTH the Tomcat access log and exclusions.log — recorded nowhere. The quieter tier below excluded-prefixes (which still writes an exclusions.log audit line). Checked first, so a path matching both is silenced. Default silences the log viewer's own self-traffic (/admin/logs/inflight poll, /data, /page, /trace, css/js) while keeping the /admin/logs page load in exclusions.log. Add e.g. /actuator/health here to silence probe noise.

properties.name: log-viewer.request-attribute
properties.description: Name of a per-request attribute appended to the access log as the final token (%{name}r) and surfaced in the /admin/logs/data JSON under this same key. The app sets it via request.setAttribute(name, value); logged verbatim (no masking), so never point it at a secret. Empty (the default) disables the trailing token — opt in deliberately, e.g. set it to 'apiKey' or 'tenantId'.

properties.name: log-viewer.compression-log-prefixes
properties.description: Filename prefixes of the log families the compression task compresses (each swept independently). The task compresses only — it never deletes archives. Default: access_log, catalina, error, exclusions, slow, bodies.

properties.name: log-viewer.body.enabled
properties.description: Opt-in request/response body capture. When true, BodyCaptureFilter wraps every request and writes one JSON line per request to bodies.log, correlated by X-Request-Id. Off by default: bodies routinely carry credentials and personal data, and capture buffers both directions in memory.

properties.name: log-viewer.body.max-bytes
properties.description: Per-side cap in bytes for captured bodies. Longer bodies are truncated and the captured JSON carries reqTruncated/resTruncated=true.

properties.name: log-viewer.body.redact-keys
properties.description: Case-insensitive JSON keys whose values are replaced with "***" before a body is written. Flat regex substitution — it does NOT traverse nested JSON, so review bodies.log before treating it as safe to share. Default: password, secret, token, authorization, apiKey, api_key.

properties.name: log-viewer.body.skip-content-types
properties.description: Content-type prefixes whose bodies are never captured. Default skips multipart uploads and binary payloads: multipart/, image/, video/, audio/, application/octet-stream.

properties.name: log-viewer.compression-cron
properties.description: Cron expression for the daily task that gzips previous days' rolled log files (access + catalina/error/exclusions). Default 00:10. Set to '-' to disable. The task only compresses — it never deletes archives.

properties.name: log-viewer.access-log-time-unit
properties.description: Unit Tomcat's AccessLogValve writes the %D (duration) and %F (TTFB) tokens in. The viewer normalises both to milliseconds: MICROS divides by 1000, MILLIS leaves them unchanged. Default MICROS is historical; Tomcat documents these tokens as milliseconds, so if durations/p95 look 1000x too small, set this to MILLIS.

properties.name: log-viewer.max-compressed-read-bytes
properties.description: Largest compressed log file the viewer will decompress and read. Larger files are skipped (returned empty). Raise it to keep large daily archives visible.
